metadata.title: Milky Way Mass Through Escape Velocity Curve from LAMOST K Giants

notes: No star-level identifiers are supplied or identifiable in the paper. The high-velocity K giants are analyzed statistically as a population; the figures and tables contain binned results rather than individually identified stars (e.g., T:p3-b6, T:p5-b11). Although the paper mentions a small number of unbound stars and excludes stars with v_GC > 700 km s^-1 (T:p3-b4, T:p3-b6), it does not identify any specific star as a Galactic unbound candidate, so no star can be placed on the roster.
